cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've shut my notebook like you. That's how you finish being chair. I told them no more years; please notice what that took.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I shut mine because the minutes were finished. Could you stay until we find somebody?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, properly finished. I rehearsed that refusal in your car until I stopped apologising. Please don't turn it into 'not yet'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll tell them you're exhausted and need a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give them the excuse I spent an hour taking out. Tell them I said no without one.

reason: Replace prefatory Stance slogans with a mistaken copied cue and a confident cover that changes how A delegates, probes, recruits hope, names fear indirectly, or seeks recognition of effort.
